what: Proposed stat_mtime tries BSD stat -f before GNU stat -c with only a non-empty check
scenario_or_breakage: GNU stat treats -f as --file-system and can succeed with multi-line non-numeric output on Linux; prune order becomes arbitrary or unstable while CI/production assume Linux-first behavior elsewhere
suggested_fix: Use the repo pattern from scripts/lib-external-launcher-common.sh:96-106: try stat -c %Y then stat -f %m, accept only ^[0-9]+$, else 0
